## Hookshot · Allow Games Edition — AG BETA v1.4

**Source only. No game, no keys, no executable.** Build it from **your own legally owned copy**. Not affiliated with Nintendo.

### A native 60
With upstream's fps gain in v1.3, the game now holds a **native 60 fps** on our test PC (i7-14700K, RTX 3070, 1440p,
Quality preset Balanced, full resolution): every measurement at 60.0, no frame over 22 ms, GPU at about 13 ms a frame. No
frame generation, so no added input lag. So the **FPS lock is now off by default**.

If your PC can't hold 60, open the Insert menu and set **FPS lock** to **60** (an even 30 plus frame generation) or **30**,
or lower **Resolution**. Measurements: [docs/allowgames-performance.md](../../docs/allowgames-performance.md).

### Updating
Accept the game's update offer at start, or download `HookshotBuilder.zip`, extract it to a new folder and build into the
same game folder: saves and settings stay (a lock you chose before stays as you set it).

Credits: NotRexed (Hookshot), EvilBoyce/evilmfkr, hckrman101 and every upstream contributor. Edition changes by AllGamersRD / Allow Games. GPL-3.0-or-later.
